capabilities: Render notes as stacked paper-like pages with visible page gaps
Force manual page breaks with marker lines
Adjust paper size, margins, and point-size type from a control bar or commands
Zoom the paginated view without reflow and remember zoom per note
Tint the backdrop from light to near-black to reduce distractions
extras: Desktop only; tested mainly with the Minimal theme and other themes may render page gaps, image widths, or backgrounds incorrectly. Pagination is an editor layout aid, not a print/PDF typesetter. No default hotkey is assigned.
motivation: The author wants writers to see text the way it will eventually print, without chrome, sidebars, or line-length surprises.
problem: Obsidian's editor is a continuous scroll with no print-like pagination, making it hard to judge page flow and text size while writing long-form prose.
summary: Distraction-free writing mode that renders the editor as paginated, paper-like pages with book trim sizes, point-size type, margins, and a soft backdrop.
